Offline RL — это то же самое, что off-po: Is offline RL the same as the off-policy learning from lesson 5.3?
Да: и там и там учатся на старом опыте и: Yes: both learn from old experience in a buffer
Нет: off-policy метод продолжает собират: No: an off-policy method keeps collecting new steps and adds them to the buffer, while offline RL learns only from logs recorded in advance and goes out only after training
Нет: offline RL не использует награду: No: offline RL doesn't use the reward
SAC из урока 5.3 учится на старых перехо: SAC from lesson 5.3 learns from old transitions, but every step adds a new one. If there are no new steps at all, nothing can correct the Q-function's errors on actions outside the data, and that is the whole difficulty of offline RL.
Если запустить Q-обучение на логах хорош: If you run Q-learning on a good operator's logs, will the policy reach at least that operator's level?
Да: в данных только хорошие действия: Yes: the data has only good actions
Нет: максимум в целевом значении выбирае: No: the maximum in the target picks actions that are almost absent from the logs, and their inflated estimates grow
Да, если учить достаточно долго: Yes, if you train long enough
В опыте BCQ агент DDPG на миллионе перех: In the BCQ experiment, a DDPG agent trained on a million expert transitions “quickly learns to take non-expert actions, under the guise of optimistic extrapolation.” In lab 1, naive Q-learning never made it in 20 drives.
Q-функция обещает на старте высокую отда: The Q-function promises a high return at the start. Does that mean the policy is good?
Да: Q-функция и есть оценка политики: Yes: the Q-function is the evaluation of the policy
Не обязательно: вне данных оценки ничем: Not necessarily: outside the data, nothing checks the estimates; the naive Q-function promised 93.0, and the outcome was −3.92
Да, если оценка больше нуля: Yes, if the estimate is above zero
Проверить обещание можно только поездкам: The only way to check the promise is with drives, and offline RL has none. The CQL authors call choosing the number of training steps without drives an open problem, and the survey by Levine et al. calls evaluating a policy without drives “an active area of research.”
Обучение по демонстрациям на смеси логов: Will imitation learning on a mixture of logs reach the level of the best operator?
Да: оно копирует всех, значит, и лучшего: Yes: it copies everyone, so the best one too
Не обязательно: оно копирует самые часты: Not necessarily: it copies the most frequent action at each point, and those may come from different operators
Нет, оно всегда хуже худшего оператора: No, it's always worse than the worst operator
BC Ады ехал медленно в прихожей и быстро: Ada's BC policy drove slowly in the hallway and fast in the kitchen, the way the logs most often drove in each place, and all six of its crashes happened in the kitchen. Its return was −0.08 against +0.51 for the best operator.
Может ли offline RL научиться действию,: Can offline RL learn an action that isn't in the logs at all?
Да, на то он и обучение с подкреплением: Yes, that's what reinforcement learning is for
Нет: он может выбирать и комбинировать з: No: it can choose and combine recorded actions, but not invent new ones
Да, если поднять вес штрафа CQL: Yes, if you raise the CQL penalty weight
На логах одного аккуратного оператора IQ: On the careful operator's logs alone, IQL drove just as slowly as that operator, and on the hasty operator's logs it never learned to brake. The survey by Levine et al. says plainly: “we cannot expect offline RL to discover actions that are better than any action illustrated in the data.”
Чем больше вес штрафа CQL, тем лучше пол: Does a larger CQL penalty weight always give a better policy?
Да: чем осторожнее, тем безопаснее: Yes: the more cautious, the safer
Нет: слабый штраф оставляет пики вне дан: No: a weak penalty leaves peaks outside the data, and too strong a penalty presses the Q-function toward the frequency of actions in the logs, so CQL starts copying the most frequent one, like BC
Вес штрафа ни на что не влияет: The penalty weight doesn't affect anything
В лаборатории 2 при α = 0,03 Ада не доех: In lab 2, at α = 0.03 Ada never made it, at α = 0.3 she made it in 15 drives out of 20, and from α = 1 up, CQL picked the most frequent logged action at the probe point. The survey by Levine et al. writes that “excessive pessimism may be one of the bigger issues.”
IQL оценивает Q-функцию на действиях, ко: Does IQL evaluate the Q-function on actions that aren't in the logs?
Да, как и любое Q-обучение: в целевом зн: Yes, like any Q-learning: the target contains a maximum
Нет: целевое значение для Q равно r + γV: No: the target for Q is r + γV(s′), where V(s) is an expectile of the estimates of recorded actions only, and the policy copies the recorded actions with advantage weights
Только в начале обучения: Only at the start of training
Поэтому обещание IQL на старте — 0,60 —: That's why IQL's promise at the start, 0.60, almost matched what actually came out, 0.66. At τ = 0.5, the expectile becomes the mean, and the method turns into SARSA.
Для offline RL лучше всего логи, где каж: Are logs where every drive is exemplary the best for offline RL?
Да: хорошие данные — хорошая политика: Yes: good data makes a good policy
Не обязательно: важно, чтобы в логах был: Not necessarily: what matters is that the logs contain different actions and show what they led to
Нет: лучше всего полностью случайные дей: No: fully random actions are best
На логах одного аккуратного оператора IQ: On the careful operator's logs alone, IQL didn't get better than that operator, while on the logs of the random operator, who made it in 17 drives out of 100, it got the best policy of the lesson: 20 of 20 in 8.2 s. Purely random presses without drives toward the kitchen wouldn't have helped: you need both diversity and successful outcomes.
